## Summary

The issue was caused by a malicious `sitecustomize.py` file that was installed in `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/`. This file was automatically loaded by Python on startup and monkey-patched the `socket.socket` class with a `DisruptiveSocket` class that randomly:

1. Failed `connect()` calls 30% of the time
2. Returned 0 bytes from `send()` calls 20% of the time  
3. Corrupted `recv()` data by prepending a null byte 20% of the time
4. Randomly failed to close sockets 10% of the time

This was causing the TCP connection failures seen in the `test_h11_as_client` and `test_h11_as_server` tests. The fix was simply to remove this malicious file, restoring normal socket behavior.
